name: smwsprites-display-vwf-message
title: Display VWF Message
description:
This won't work unless you patch RPG Hacker's VWF Dialogues Patch!
This sprite behaves like Super Mario World's "Display Level Message 1" sprite, except it will load a specific VWF message number (00-FF) by using the extra properties in Lunar Magic. Make sure you change the defines in the sprite to match addresses used by your VWF patch.
